remarks: Experience unparalleled coastal living in this exquisite modern beach-style residence, masterfully crafted by the award-winning Braydan Construction. Nestled in a private association with access to a neighborhood beach and small craft launch, this home offers a seamless blend of modern design and coastal tranquility. The 5 bedroom, 4 1/2 bath home embodies thoughtful architectural details and luxurious amenities, offering an ideal retreat for those seeking a sophisticated yet relaxed lifestyle. An open concept first floor has a living room, dining area, family room and fabulous kitchen. The back of the house is all glass including nano doors with access to the heated salt water pool, outdoor kitchen and patio all surrounded by glass railings ensuring unobstructed views. On the second floor is the airy primary suite with waterside balcony and 3 additional bedrooms with 2 more bathrooms. The wide board oak floors are consistent throughout the house including the third level where the 5th bedroom and bath are located as well as another family or rec room. Beautifully landscaped and ready to move in, the home is just seconds from the town beach, Old Greenwich shopping village and Metro North train station. This is truly a lifestyle most only dream of!
